description: Image Description: A hot dog is presented on a wooden cutting board against a vibrant red background. The hot dog consists of a grilled sausage nestled in a soft, golden-brown bun. It is topped with a generous amount of yellow mustard and a dollop of ketchup, along with a small garnish of fresh green herbs, possibly parsley or cilantro.
